feats.title: Angelic Protection
feats.description: When you use lay on hands, you can instead grant the target temporary hit points equal to the number of hit points it would have regained.

feats.title: Chosen Defender
feats.description: Enemies adjacent to you take a -2 penalty to attack rolls on opportunity attacks against your allies.

feats.title: Contagious Challenge
feats.description: When you hit an enemy marked by your divine challenge, you also subject one enemy adjacent to the target to your divine sanction. This divine sanction lasts until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Forceful Challenge
feats.description: When a creature takes damage from your divine challenge or divine sanction, you can slide that creature 1 square after the triggering attack is resolved.

feats.title: Fulfilled Vow
feats.description: The first time in an encounter that you reduce an enemy marked by you to 0 or fewer hit points, you gain a +5 bonus to your next damage roll before the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Hero's Poise
feats.description: When you succeed on a saving throw to end an effect, each ally that can see you within 5 squares of you gains a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Honored Foe
feats.description: When a creature marked by your divine challenge or divine sanction damages you, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom.

feats.title: Just Punishment
feats.description: When an enemy reduces an ally you can see to 0 or fewer hit points, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that enemy until that ally has 1 or more hit points or until the end of the encounter.

feats.title: Persistent Challenge
feats.description: Once per encounter, if you fail to engage any target of your Divine Challenge on your turn, you can maintain the marks from that use of Divine Challenge as if you had engaged a target.

feats.title: Resurgent Attack
feats.description: When you spend a healing surge, you gain a +2 power bonus to the next attack roll you make before the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Touch of Salvation
feats.requirements: 11th level, 2 Charisma, lay on hands or virtue's touch
feats.description: When you use your lay on hands or virtue’s touch on an ally, that ally can make a saving throw with a bonus equal to your Charisma.

feats.title: Untiring Virtue
feats.description: Whenever you reach a milestone, you gain one additional use of your ardent vow, virtue’s touch, or lay on hands for today.

feats.title: Virtue's Chosen
feats.description: Your virtue's touch can also remove ongoing damage.

feats.title: Warding Shield
feats.description: When you are using a shield, allies adjacent to you gain a +2 shield bonus to Reflex.

feats.title: Wrathful Conviction
feats.description: The extra damage dealt by Divine Strength increases by your Charisma or Wisdom. This is in addition to its normal extra damage equal to your Strength plus half your level.
